children.name: mappedBy
children.description:
The name of the relationship as defined in the other
data model. This is only required by the `belongsTo` and `manyToMany`
relationship method.

children.name: pivotTable
children.description:
The name of the pivot table
created in the database for this relationship.

children.name: joinColumn
children.description: The column name in the pivot table that for the current entity

children.name: inverseJoinColumn
children.description: The column name in the pivot table for the opposite entity

children.name: pivotEntity
children.description:
A function that returns the data model
representing the pivot table created in the
database for this relationship.
